text:
samir: Kicking off SurgeGrace catalog enable for model tempest-9b-v1 in eu-west. Change window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Planning staged traffic siphon: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Calling out fallback ordering and rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: deploy-request accepted: manifest m-20260322-sg, canary group 'sg-eu-1' created. Scheduled at 02:05 UTC.

maya: +1. Ops: set circuit-breaker latency threshold 300ms (95p), error rate >0.5% for 3min -> automatic rollback. :rotating_light:

lee: For fallback ordering, prefer tempest-9b-quant -> tempest-7b-fp16 -> baseline-halo-3b. Ensure KV-cache compatibility and tokenizer parity across variants.

olivia: Draft release-note snippet: 
```
Tempest-9b-v1 (inference-optimized) rolled out as staged enable. Expected throughput improvements for medium-context workloads. Fallback order: quant -> smaller-fp16 -> baseline. Change window and rollback criteria included.
Owners: @samir, @maya.
```

qa-bot: Preflight smoke at 02:10 UTC: basic generation ✅, function-call examples ✅, embeddings sanity ✅. Median latency 210ms, p95 340ms. No obvious OOM.

samir: Pin policy: do NOT auto-swap for enterprise-tier accounts. Add pin rule: account_prefix ent- -> baseline-halo-3b. Also add opt-in flag for early-adopter orgs.

ops-lead: Agree. Also enable a manual pause button in the deploy UI. If any of these fire: 1) error_rate >0.5% sustained 3m, 2) p95 > 450ms for 5m, 3) increase in hallucination score by +5 pts -> pause and rollback.

maya: Small ask: add a preflight check to verify variant-priority map exists and that tempest-9b-v1 has an explicit fallback list. If missing, block rollout.

deploy-bot: canary group 'sg-eu-1' started, 2% traffic siphon at 02:05. Logs: https://internal.corp/logs/m-20260322-sg (internal).

lee: Noted a small tail latency bump when we ran 10% in staging earlier. Proposal: cap seq_len to 1024 for canary traffic to reduce worst-case kernels.

samir: Good call. Adding runtime override for canary: seq_cap=1024. Will add to manifest before the 10% step.

olivia: Final ops checklist before 10%:
- release notes up to date
- pin rules applied for enterprise
- manifest contains seq_cap override for canary
- oncall 1 assigned (maya)
- post-rollout monitoring dashboard linked

qa-bot: Canary 2% -> health OK at 02:12. p95 330ms, error rate 0.12%. Proceed to 10% at 02:15 per plan.

deploy-bot: Traffic increased to 10% at 02:15. Canary config: seq_cap=1024, kv_cache_shared=true.

lee: Watching metrics. If p95 > 420ms or error_rate >0.3% we pause.

samir: If 10% stable for 15m, we step to 50%. If any threshold crossed, rollback path: drain to 0% and re-pin affected accounts. Postmortem window: 24h retention for debug traces.

ops-lead: Also ensure deploy-bot exposes the rollback reason in the release notes and tags the manifest with rollback_reason.

olivia: Owners: samir (lead), maya (ops), lee (runtime). Publish release notes after 100% cutover.

samir: Proceeding. Thanks all — will call out in #incidents if anything fires.
